text:
Sara K: Heads-up — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1289 needs 2x LGTM before the 11:00 PT cutoff. It contains the schema change + kv-cache fix.
Josh L: CI is green for me, ran smoke locally against staging, kv-cache looks stable. :thumbsup:
Marta P: I can do a design pass but need the DB owner signoff for the migration plan (adds column, backfill + lock-free strategy).
Sara K: @Priya S — can you review the migration plan? we need DB + design signoff or we autobackout at cutoff.
Priya S: Looking now. Quick Q: backfill runs as async job after deploy, correct? Want to make sure it has retries and idempotency.
Josh L: yes async job with idempotent checks, retry loop + rate limit. I added logs and a small ramp config.
Priya S: pinging DB team slack channel for a quick glance — will post notes here in 15m.
deploy-bot: scheduled cutover window: 2024-06-15 18:00 UTC (cutoff in 45m). Autobackout policy enabled if missing 2 approvals.
Marta P: design looks fine overall — one tiny nit on naming but not blocking.
Priya S: DB review: backfill looks safe, migration fast path uses no table rewrite, index added concurrently, I want to see a smoke run on a canary member.
Sara K: can someone run a canary smoke? I can kick it off in ~10m. If canary OK, Priya will add her LGTM.
Josh L: I'll run the canary smoke and report results. Command I use: `./scripts/smoke.sh --target canary --subset kv`.
Josh L: canary smoke: passed 5/5 warmup + token regen, latency within SLOs. no obvious errors in logs.
Priya S: thanks — LGTM from DB side. leaving a review on the PR now.
Marta P: LGTM (design) — leaving review.
Sara K: Awesome — we have 2x LGTM. Proceeding with merge and cutover plan. I will watch the rollout and post status. :rocket:
deploy-bot: deploy started: runtime v2.3.1 canary -> 3 nodes. tracking at https://deploys/redwood/1289
Josh L: monitoring metrics dashboard, will call out if error spike.
Sara K: If anything goes sideways, autobackout will trigger at +10m after failure threshold. Agree on go/no-go? :eyes:
Priya S: agreed, standby for rollback if error rate > 2% for 2 consecutive 60s windows.
Sara K: thanks all — closing loop.
